The '''Ariwook''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Color/Legends|brown]], [[Hair/Legends|hairy]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] with black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up">''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]''</ref> Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]'' is set by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] events of {{Film|IV}} take place, which corresponds to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> a member of the species, [[Rff Huff]], visited [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]],<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" /> located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> and engaged in a [[Lightfight|shootout]] with the [[Ganimed]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Purong]].<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" />

==Behind the scenes==
An Ariwook first appeared in ''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]'', written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]], illustrated by [[Ralph McQuarrie]], and published in [[1995]].<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" />
